tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search for events near a location with optional filters. Every event returns a description: the organizer's own copy when the source published one, otherwise a factual summary generated from the listing (venue, local date and time, category, organizer, lineup). tools.name: get_event_details
tools.description: Get full details for a specific event by its ID. Returns the complete, untruncated description, venue details, local timezone, lineup, ticket URL, catalog rank, predicted end time when the listing omitted one, and a publishable ticket offer.

tools.name: get_event_weeks
tools.description: List upcoming conference weeks, festivals, and multi-day event series (like ETH Denver, Devconnect, Token2049). Use this to help users plan trips around major conferences.

tools.name: get_event_week_details
tools.description: Get full details for a conference week including all its side events. Use this to help users see everything happening during a major conference.

tools.name: search_event_weeks
tools.description: Search event weeks by name, description, or city. Use this to find specific conferences or festivals.

tools.name: get_event_week_cities
tools.description: List cities that have upcoming event weeks with their counts. Use this to discover where major conferences are happening.

tools.name: get_event_week_tags
tools.description: List all tags used in event weeks with their counts. Use this to discover types of conferences available.

tools.name: get_cities
tools.description: List cities that have events, with statistics like total events and recent activity. Use this to help users discover active event scenes.

tools.name: get_venues
tools.description: List venues in a city with their event history. Use this to help users find popular venues or discover new spots.

tools.name: get_event_schedule
tools.description: Get the DJ/artist schedule for a festival or party event. Returns set times, stages, and artists. Use this to answer questions like 'What time does ANOTR play?' or 'What's happening at AYA on New Year's Eve?'

tools.name: get_now_playing
tools.description: Get what's currently playing at festival/party events. Returns live stage information with current artists. Use this to answer 'What's on now?' or 'Who's playing right now at AYA?'

tools.name: search_artists
tools.description: Search artists by name and get every performance we know about, across all sources. Artist records include nullable mbid and cross-provider-verified spotify_id fields for stable matching. Use this to find when and where a specific artist is playing. tools.name: get_artist
tools.description: Get one artist's profile, nullable mbid and verified spotify_id, upcoming dates, and recent history. Provide artist_id, slug, or name. Use this to answer 'Tell me about Tale of Us' or 'What is Objekt up to?'

tools.name: get_artist_events
tools.description: List one artist's stable identity and performances with filtering and pagination. The artist includes nullable mbid and verified spotify_id. Use this to answer 'Where is Peggy Gou playing in Europe next month?' or to page through a touring artist's full schedule. Each performance carries ticket_url,

tools.name: list_artists
tools.description: Browse artists with nullable mbid and verified spotify_id fields, optionally scoped to a city or country. Ordered by how many performances we track. Use this to answer 'Who is playing in Berlin this month?' or 'Which artists tour most?'

tools.name: search_organizers
tools.description: Search organizer profiles enriched from event data. Returns organizer names, source, website/contact details, Instagram profile URL plus handle, and scrape status.
